HV_S0.name: continuous / DC current
HV_S0.rationale: continuous 48 V draw; some hybrid topologies are explicitly designed for this (10.1109/JSSC.2024.3485210, CONTEXT_ONLY)

HV_S1.name: constant square pulse at the buck duty
HV_S1.rationale: MINIMUM RMS for support exactly D; NOT an upper bound

HV_S2.name: square pulse at the overall ratio V_out/V_in
HV_S2.rationale: the duty the DVPD source's Eq.(5) assumes -- it states the relation is valid 'when the input current waveform is nearly a square pulse with duty cycle proportional to Vout/Vin', for buck-derived INCLUDING HYBRID converters in CCM. Our 3:1 SC front end may or may not behave that way; still a scenario.

Z1.lv_form: P = 49 * I_cell_rms^2 * (R_VDD + R_GND); fields are separate
Z1.inter_cell_phase_reason: no conductor is shared between cells, so no cross term I_m*I_n enters the Joule sum; phase alignment would only matter for a shared conductor
